omission.chore: Get guidance on safely repairing an existing self-hosted workflow without unintended changes.
omission.evidenceQuote: We need guidance on safely repairing an existing workflow in self-hosted n8n 2.30.4 , without risking unintended changes.
omission.reason: This is an explicit request for safe repair guidance. A bounded prototype using operator supplied workflow details with human review could be assessed; lack of an implementation reference does not by itself justify excluding it without scoring.
